$comment: Suites run one at a time. They all share the single local Postgres, and
sync.e2e asserts on delta *pages*: concurrent writes from another suite
push its tombstone above the safe cursor and the assertion fails (seen
twice). Each suite also boots its own Nest app with migrationsRun, so
serial execution stops them racing the same DDL when a migration lands.
Costs a few seconds; removes the whole class of flake.
